decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry, a commit title listed under Bug fixes: "fix: Only port-forward to ready pods" [ev-c17a311dcffd]. It doesn't say which component does the port-forwarding, what happened before the fix, or what an operator would notice. So it can't tell us whether this is a behavior-change to review or just a fix with no operational consequence (none). The proposed statement says that "previously reachable" non-ready pods will "no longer be established". Nothing in the evidence says that, and the medium severity has no support either. To decide, we need the PR or issue text (#10610 / #22794) or release notes that describe the before and after behavior and its effect on users.
